text:
alex: PTAL on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234 — I addressed reviewer comments and added tests. Left two small open questions inline (semver decision + whether to add a quick smoke job). Can someone take a look when free?

jess: taking a look now, thanks. quick Q — is the API change additive? do we need a minor version bump or patch?

alex: it’s additive in the request shape (new optional field). no breaking behavior when omitted. I was leaning patch because the server accepts old payloads, but tagging it minor would be safer for consumers who pin exact semver.

jess: hmm ok. If it’s optional and backward-compatible, patch is fine. but we should call it out in the changelog and release notes.

alex: agree — I'll add a line to CHANGELOG.md.

tim: quick ops question — when do we want to canary this? I can schedule tonight if that works.

alex: tonight is fine. aim for the 9pm UTC canary window. I’ll coordinate rollback steps.

olga: can we also add a lightweight smoke script in CI so we catch obvious regressions? something that runs against canary namespace only.

alex: added smoke script in the PR. command is: 
```
./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --target=canary --timeout=60
```

alex: also updated the PR description with canary instructions and rollback checklist.

ci-bot: CircleCI: build passed — all unit/integration checks green. smoke stage queued.

ci-bot: Smoke job completed: success (ran ./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh against canary).

jess: :thumbsup: Looks good to me. please add the small changelog line and then ship when canary is green.

tim: lgtm from ops side, schedule confirmed for 21:00 UTC. I’ll monitor and ping here if anything odd.

olga: thanks for adding smoke. once changelog is in, I can approve in GitHub.

alex: changelog line pushed. also included a small note in the release notes template.

jess: approved.

olga: approved.

tim: approved.

alex: thanks all — merging to canary now. will follow up after the canary holds for 30m. :rocket:
